key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0960
name: call_indirect_hook_if_set
description: If a global pointer slot is non-zero, calls the routine whose address it holds. It then calls a further routine with no arguments, which the decompiler shows as this same routine, so the code recurses into itself.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0962
name: call_indirect_if_flagged_recurse
description: Calls the routine held in a global pointer slot when that slot is non-zero, then makes a no-argument call to another routine. The code shows that second call returning into this same routine, so it recurses into itself.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0980
name: process_resource_descriptor
description: Walks a descriptor held in a register-based structure, calling a routine for each non-zero field and storing one value through a pointer field. When a bit in a global flag byte is set it calls the exec supervisor function, and it finishes by returning a value taken from the stack frame.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0A9C
name: release_resource_slot
description: Checks that a slot index is in range and that the slot is in use, otherwise sets an error code and returns failure. If the slot's flag bit is clear it closes the stored handle through the dos close wrapper, then clears the slot and returns success.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0B08
name: call_current_dir
description: Loads the dos library base from a global slot and jumps to the library's CurrentDir function through its vector, returning whatever that function returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0B7C
name: call_indirect_routine_via_table
description: Loads a routine address from a table held in a global block and calls it with no arguments, then returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0B94
name: dispatch_library_vector_414
description: Jumps through the library vector at offset -414 from the library base pointer held in a global slot, which in turn calls an unnamed routine. No arguments are set up in this stub.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0B98
name: call_library_vector_414
description: Calls the library function at vector offset -414 from the library base pointer held in a global slot and returns the result. The stub sets up no arguments of its own.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:PROG:0:0000
name: run_startup_and_free_memory
description: Program entry for this hunk. It calls two routines, invokes a routine address taken from an address register, then runs a three-pass loop that calls the library's free-memory function through the library base. It clears a stored longword and returns the two result registers.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:PROG:0:003C
name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit register variable in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:HERO:0:0000
name: unpack_compressed_hunk_data
description: Program entry for this hunk. It decompresses data by reading bits backwards from longwords and writing bytes downward in memory, copying earlier output for back-references, and it calls routines to fetch the next longword and length values.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:HERO:0:0106
name: read_shifted_previous_longword
description: Reads the 32-bit value just before the address register, shifts it right by one bit, sets its top bit and returns the result.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:HERO:0:0120
name: shift_bit_stream_backwards
description: Shifts a bit register right one place. When it empties, it reloads it from the longword before the address register with the top bit set as a marker, repeating for a count taken from another register and returning when that count runs out.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0000
name: deferred_callback_dispatcher
description: Checks a one-bit flag in a global byte. If the flag was clear, it stores the data register value into a global word, calls a routine through an indirect pointer computed from that value, and then clears the flag.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:047C
name: initialize_sound_stream_state
description: Initialises a sound channel state block. When the stream's first byte is zero it builds a four-entry channel map from a bit mask and clears the playback fields. When the first byte is two it parses the stream header, sets up the sample offsets, and converts the sample bytes in place by subtracting 128.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:04AC
name: set_status_and_clear_byte
description: Stores zero through the address register and sets a status word in the structure to three, then returns that status word.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:04B8
name: parse_sound_stream_header
description: Scans forward through a byte stream to a terminator byte, recording its length. It reads a 16-bit rate value from the header, maps it to one of three stored constants by comparing it with two fixed rates, and sets the structure's offset and mask fields from header bytes.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:05AA
name: decode_sound_command_block
description: Initialises a sound command block in a caller-provided structure, decodes a stream of bytes through a mask from a global variable to select up to four channel values, writes them into a 16-byte buffer and terminates it, clears several command fields, and returns a status word from the structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:061C
name: check_bell_and_write_byte
description: Checks whether the byte at the stream pointer is the bell character and whether a flag in the structure is clear. If both hold, it stores a value computed from the following byte into a table indexed by a register.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0642
name: store_byte_conditional
description: Checks a global variable against four. If it is not equal, it stores a byte from the stream pointer into a table addressed by a global base and an index register, then returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0656
name: store_byte_or_mark_end
description: Reads a byte from the stream pointer. If it is the end marker 127 it records the distance from the stream base as a length; otherwise it stores the byte into a word field of the structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0670
name: store_word_field_value
description: Stores the word held in the data register into a field of the address-register structure and returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0676
name: advance_sound_stream_decoder
description: Advances the sound stream decoder by one step. It reads command bytes from the stream, branches on their high nibble for special commands such as end markers and jumps, updates the timing counters in the channel structure, and returns the new stream offset.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:069A
name: reset_playback_state
description: Clears a global word, sets a field in the structure to minus one, sets a channel state byte to two and returns zero.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:06B2
name: advance_channel_state_machine
description: Advances a channel state machine driven by a state byte. State two moves to three and calls a routine. State three clears a flag, calls two routines and moves to state four. Other states count down a timer, call routines and step the stream, and the function returns a value when the sequence ends.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:06CC
name: service_channel_timer_step
description: When the channel state byte is three, it clears a flag, calls two routines and moves the state to four. Otherwise it counts down a per-channel timer, and when the timer expires it clears the timer flags and returns a result. If the timer is idle it sets a word field to minus one and the state byte to two.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:06EA
name: countdown_channel_timer_step
description: Counts down a channel timer byte and, when it reaches zero, reloads it and decrements a global count. When that count runs out it clears the channel flag and returns zero. Otherwise it calls a routine and, if a global variable is zero, sets a word field to minus one and the state byte to two.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0714
name: clear_sound_state
description: Calls a routine, then if a global variable is zero it writes the value minus one into a word field of the structure and sets a channel state byte to two. It returns zero.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0738
name: run_sound_stream_decoder_step
description: Reads the next command from a sound byte stream, first handling a pending flag by calling a routine. It branches on the high nibble of each command byte for end, repeat and jump codes, and for data bytes it updates the duration counter. It records the stream offset and channel state in the structure before returning.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0792
name: parse_sound_command_bytes
description: Parses command bytes from the sound stream until a data byte or a timing limit is reached, handling command codes such as end markers and jumps. It then stores the channel's current command and offset back into the structure and returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:07A6
name: record_channel_position_and_wait
description: Decrements a wait counter in the structure, stores the current command and command value bytes, and records the stream offset relative to the stream base.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:07AE
name: scan_sound_commands_until_end
description: Loops over sound command bytes, handling the end-of-stream code and the other command codes. When the end code is reached it calls a routine to finish the sequence.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:07BE
name: process_sound_command_stream
description: Reads sound command bytes in a loop, dispatching command codes for end, repeat and skip to their handlers. It calls routines to update channel state and the stream offset as it goes, and returns once an end command is reached.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:07FA
name: accumulate_sound_wait_counter
description: Skips the operand bytes of a command, adds the following wait byte to the channel's wait counter, and stores the command and offset back into the structure. It returns when the counter is zero or a limit is reached.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0810
name: dispatch_sound_control_codes
description: Dispatches a sound control code. The end code calls a routine and returns, the repeat code loops over data bytes until a terminator, the two-byte and three-byte codes skip their operands, and other values add the next wait byte to the counter.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0826
name: skip_sound_command_operands
description: Skips the operand bytes that follow a sound command, which are one, two or three bytes depending on the code, or a run ending at a terminator byte. It then updates the channel's wait counter and stored position.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0836
name: advance_sound_stream_past_operands
description: Advances the stream pointer past the operand bytes of a two-byte or three-byte sound command, then stores the channel position and wait value in the structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0842
name: parse_next_sound_command
description: Advances past a single operand byte for one command code. Unless a wait is pending or the limit is reached, it reads the next command byte and continues parsing.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0850
name: handle_midi_channel_message
description: Compares a channel number with the channel index stored in the structure. On a match it handles MIDI-style status bytes: note-on, note-off, control change and program change each call a routine that consumes their data bytes, after which wait bytes update the counters.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0866
name: handle_midi_status_messages
description: Handles MIDI-style note-off, control change and program change status codes. Each calls a routine that consumes its data bytes, then a run of data bytes is added into the wait counter.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0872
name: handle_midi_control_program_messages
description: Handles the control change and program change status codes. Each calls a routine that consumes its data bytes, then a run of data bytes is added to the wait counter and the stream pointer is updated.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:087E
name: handle_midi_program_change
description: Handles the program change status code by calling a routine that consumes its data byte. It then adds the following run of data bytes into the wait counter and stores the stream position.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08A0
name: forward_to_stream_handler
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, forwarding the call to the stream handler.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08A4
name: store_channel_bytes_and_offset
description: Stores two byte values into the structure and sets its position word to the argument minus the stream base.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08BE
name: reset_sound_driver_state
description: Sets a word field to minus one, copies a saved position word into the stream position field, calls a routine, then sets a flag byte and clears a wait word in the structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08DA
name: clamp_and_scale_value
description: Caps a 16-bit value in the structure at 64 and, when a flag byte in the structure is zero, stores four times that value in a global word.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08FA
name: restore_saved_word_and_call
description: Saves a word field of the structure, clears it, calls a routine four times, then restores the saved word.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0920
name: call_routine_then_set_flag
description: Calls a routine, then sets a flag byte in the structure to one.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:092A
name: arm_channel_countdown
description: Sets a channel flag byte to one and a countdown byte to eight in the structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0938
name: configure_audio_channel_zero
description: Disables interrupts through the exec library, programs audio channel zero's pointer, length, period and volume from a structure, sets its DMA enable bit and interrupt enable bit, then re-enables interrupts. It sets a flag in the structure before returning.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0988
name: configure_audio_channel_one
description: Disables interrupts through the exec library, programs audio channel one's pointer, length, period and volume from a structure, sets its DMA enable bit and interrupt enable bit, then re-enables interrupts. It sets a flag in the structure before returning.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:09D8
name: configure_audio_channel_two
description: Disables interrupts through the exec library, programs audio channel two's pointer, length, period and volume from a structure, sets its DMA enable bit and interrupt enable bit, then re-enables interrupts. It sets a flag in the structure before returning.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0A28
name: configure_audio_channel_three
description: Disables interrupts through the exec library, programs audio channel three's pointer, length, period and volume from a structure, sets its DMA enable bit and interrupt enable bit, then re-enables interrupts. It sets a flag in the structure before returning.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0A78
name: set_audio_dma_control
description: Builds a one-bit channel mask from the input value, writes it to the DMA control register, and writes a shifted copy of the mask to the interrupt enable register.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0A90
name: step_sound_channel_slots
description: Walks four channel slots in a sound structure, copying each slot's pending value from a table. For active slots it calls routines and adjusts the slot counters that step toward a threshold.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0AB6
name: process_sound_channel_entries
description: For the given channel index it returns immediately when the index is six. Otherwise it walks that channel's entries from the structure, copying each pending byte from a table and calling routines that update the entry's counters.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0AFC
name: step_sound_slot_levels
description: Subtracts a value from a slot's level and advances the slot index when the level falls below its threshold. It decrements a counter and walks to the next active slot, returning once all four slots have been visited.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0B14
name: retire_finished_sound_slots
description: Walks the four sound slots. A slot that has reached its end code has its counter and per-slot field cleared and a routine called to finish it; other active slots are loaded from a table and their counters updated.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0B38
name: write_audio_register_value
description: Multiplies an input value by a scale factor from a global variable, shifts the result right six places, and stores it into the audio channel register selected by an index.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0B52
name: set_audio_channel_scaled_level
description: Scales a global value by a second copy of itself and by a per-slot byte from a table, shifts the result, and stores it into the audio channel volume register chosen by the slot index.
